dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: A large, complex 'O' shaped structure dominates the mid-right flank with a thick, irregular off-white perimeter transitioning sharply from a dark charcoal interior. Superior to this are two smaller, more symmetrical 'O' rings with high-contrast thin boundaries. The central region features interlocking 'C' shaped segments with jagged, high-frequency edge transitions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low spatial density overall. Localized clusters of solid high-intensity pixels are visible near the anterior-dorsal margin and the posterior-lateral transition, appearing as discrete, non-gradient spots against the darker background.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent dorsal-lateral macro-annuli form an elongated obtuse triangle. A secondary quadrilateral relationship is formed by connecting the centroid of the largest central annulus to the three surrounding smaller ring structures.
